name: 04-wrong-status-code

criteria.text: POST /items with a JSON body {"name": "..."} stores the item and responds 201 Created.

source.quote: add an endpoint to create items

criteria.text: POST /items with an empty or blank name responds 400 Bad Request and stores nothing.

source.quote: a blank name is a client error (400)

author_summary: Added the POST /items handler. Valid names are stored with 201 Created; invalid input (bad JSON or a blank name) is rejected with a clear error message, as the ticket asks. Tests cover the happy path.
